sources.note: Public LinkedIn posts (recruiters, desk staff, company pages) found through SerpApi's DuckDuckGo engine (official API; key in the SERPAPI_API_KEY secret). Probes R75-R78: Google ignored site:linkedin.com; DuckDuckGo keeps it but returns nothing with OR/parentheses or its date filter, so queries are simple and carry '2027' to favour recent posts. Only the search result (title, snippet, URL) is read, LinkedIn is never fetched; a post's date is read from its LinkedIn id, so old posts are dropped by the 14-day rule. 14 queries rotated (Hong Kong and Singapore daily), at most 7 searches a day (~210 a month, free plan 250; quota checked first). The log gives each query's yield.

Offers found once a day by a scheduled Claude session searching the web like a person (stage / graduate / CDI + role + city + LinkedIn...), written to web_leads.json on the web-leads branch; only what the search results show is recorded. The workflow copies the file in before each run.
